name: MMT-LS
description: Benchmark datasets serve as the foundation for the development of related fields and are also a measure for objectively and fairly evaluating different algorithms. Currently, European historical newspaper layout analysis datasets and the Asian HJDataset have been successively released. However, there is no publicly available annotated dataset for Mongolian documents. In this paper, the Mongolian Movable-Type Datasets for Layout Segmentation (MMT-LS) is constructed.
